command:
cd /testbed && cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/repro_optics.py
import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import OPTICS, cluster_optics_xi
from sklearn.datasets import make_blobs

X, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=200, random_state=0)

# Case from the bug report: float min_samples with default cluster_method
clust = OPTICS(metric='minkowski', n_jobs=-1, min_samples=0.1)
clust.fit(X)
print("fit ok; core_distances_[:3] =", clust.core_distances_[:3])

# Xi method with float min_samples, and explicit float min_cluster_size
clust = OPTICS(min_samples=0.1, cluster_method='xi', min_cluster_size=0.1)
clust.fit(X)
print("xi fit ok; n_labels =", len(np.unique(clust.labels_)))

# Direct call of cluster_optics_xi with float sizes
clust = OPTICS(min_samples=0.05).fit(X)
labels, clusters = cluster_optics_xi(
    reachability=clust.reachability_,
    predecessor=clust.predecessor_,
    ordering=clust.ordering_,
    min_samples=0.1,
    min_cluster_size=0.1,
)
print("cluster_optics_xi ok; n_clusters =", len(clusters))
EOF
